story_log.development: CBS Sports: Thunder staring down tough roster decisions with second apron looming after losing to Spurs. Only SGA is truly indispensable. Chet's disappearance, Dort's struggles, Jalen Williams' injury history all raise questions. SGA postgame: 'I will give zero input, I will let Sam Presti, the greatest GM ever, do his job.'

story_log.title: Vikings hire Seahawks assistant GM Nolan Teasley as new GM after two Super Bowl wins in Seattle
story_log.development: Minnesota hired Teasley as GM per Pelissero and Schefter. First year in Seattle was team's first Super Bowl-winning season, now leaves after second Lombardi. Wrote letters to all 32 teams in 2013 asking for opportunity after six years in marketing, got one interview with Seahawks. 13 years later, now Vikings GM.

story_log.title: PSG wins back-to-back Champions League titles, Luis Enrique cements legacy with Arsenal defeat
story_log.development: PSG beat Arsenal on penalties to win second straight Champions League title. Luis Enrique joins Zinedine Zidane as only managers to win consecutive UCL titles in modern era. Arsenal came as close as you can to winning first UCL, fell in PKs. France celebrates: Wemby and PSG both won on May 30.

story_log.title: Shedeur Sanders shatters Tom Brady's NFLPA licensing record with $17.7M haul in rookie season
story_log.development: Browns QB Sanders earned record $17.7M in NFLPA group licensing income during rookie season, staggering total fueled by jersey sales, trading cards, and one of football's most loyal fanbases. Broke Brady's previous record.

story_log.title: Fernando Tatis Jr. finally hits first home run of season in 56th game after lengthy power drought
story_log.development: Tatis hit first homer of 2026 season in his 56th game vs Nationals. Averages 24 HR per year as big-leaguer but didn't go deep until late May. CBS Sports examined why Padres star endured lengthy drought.

story_log.title: White Sox slugger Munetaka Murakami injures hamstring, expected to miss 4-6 weeks in major blow
story_log.development: Murakami expected to miss 4-6 weeks with hamstring injury. White Sox have been pleasant surprise this season, but Murakami's absence leaves huge hole in lineup. CBS Sports reported.

story_log.title: Defending champion Coco Gauff stunned in third round of French Open by Anastasia Potapova
story_log.development: Gauff's title defense ended in third round in latest shocking upset at Roland-Garros. Lost to Potapova. CBS Sports reported.

story_log.title: Hailey Van Lith returning to Sun on developmental deal after being waived twice this month
story_log.development: Van Lith waived twice in May, now getting another chance in Connecticut on developmental deal. CBS Sports: Can the ex-college star stick in the WNBA?

story_log.title: Edmundo Sosa go-ahead homer in 8th lifts Phillies past Dodgers 4-3
story_log.development: Sosa hit go-ahead homer in 8th inning to give Phillies 4-3 win over Dodgers. TalkinBaseball_ reported.

story_log.title: Pete Alonso walks off Blue Jays in 9th as Orioles rally for five runs to complete comeback
story_log.development: Alonso hit walk-off for Orioles after five-run ninth-inning rally vs Blue Jays. Jeff Hoffman's meltdown led to comeback. TalkinBaseball_ reported.

story_log.title: Julio Rodriguez homers in third straight game as Mariners beat Diamondbacks
story_log.development: Julio hit homer in third consecutive game. Bryan Woo matched season high with 9 strikeouts in dominant outing vs Dbacks. TalkinBaseball_ reported.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong runs down fly ball to end game in St. Louis after answering 'overrated' chants
story_log.development: PCA made game-ending catch vs Cardinals after earlier blasting homer into Tarps Off section to answer 'overrated' chants. Cubs won 6-1. TalkinBaseball_ and JomboyMedia reported.

story_log.title: Braves become first team to 40 wins as Ronald Acuña Jr. homers twice in blowout of Reds
story_log.development: Acuña hit two homers vs Reds as Braves won 5-2 to become first MLB team to 40 wins. TalkinBaseball_ reported.

story_log.title: Rangers score three in 9th to walk off Royals after being down to final out
story_log.development: Texas scored 3 runs in bottom of 9th to walk off Kansas City. Down to final out before rally. TalkinBaseball_ reported.

story_log.title: Women's College World Series: Tennessee walks off in 9th, UCLA survives elimination
story_log.development: Tennessee's Emma Clarke hit first Tennessee walk-off HR in WCWS in 21 years. UCLA walked off to stay alive. Alabama advanced to semifinals for eighth time. SportsCenter and ESPN reported.

story_log.title: Toronto Tempo wins franchise debut 93-72 over Seattle Storm
story_log.development: Tempo won first game in franchise history, beating Storm 93-72. Expansion team starts 1-0.

story_log.title: Portland Fire routs Caitlin Clark and Indiana Fever 100-84
story_log.development: Fire beat Fever 100-84. Clark will play as Fever look to bounce back from tough loss per CBS Sports pregame.

story_log.title: Hurricanes eliminate Canadiens to advance to Stanley Cup Finals vs Golden Knights
story_log.development: Game 5: Carolina won 6-1 at home to close out series 4-1, advancing to Stanley Cup Finals for first time since 2006. Will face Golden Knights for championship. Frederik Andersen 23 saves, .958 SV%. Seth Jarvis open-net goal sealed it. Canada's Cup drought extends to 33 years.

story_log.title: Canada's Stanley Cup drought extends to 33 years after Canadiens elimination
story_log.development: No Canadian team has won Stanley Cup since 1993. Montreal's elimination Friday night marks 33 years without a Canadian champion. CBS Sports and ESPN both noted milestone.

story_log.title: Thunder lose Jalen Williams for Game 7 after Spurs force series decider with dominant Game 6
story_log.development: OKC ruled Jalen Williams out for Game 7 Saturday with hamstring. Spurs blew out Thunder 118-91 in Game 6 to force decider. Wemby 28 pts, 10 reb, 3 blk. Thunder shot 2-14 from three, Spurs held them to 13 points in third quarter. Series tied 3-3, Game 7 Saturday night in OKC.

story_log.title: Magic hire Spurs associate Sean Sweeney as new head coach
story_log.development: Orlando finalized deal to hire Sweeney as head coach per Shams. Will finish WCF on Spurs bench before taking over. Beat out Billy Donovan and Jeff Van Gundy. Runs San Antonio's elite defense (improved from 25th to 3rd in NBA this season).

story_log.title: 76ers hire Cavaliers GM Mike Gansey as new President of Basketball Operations
story_log.development: Sixers hired Cavs GM Gansey as President per Shams. Bob Myers led search, will partner with Gansey. Gansey rose through Cavs organization since 2011-12, served as GM under Koby Altman since 2022. Leaves Cleveland after helping build ECF contender.

story_log.title: Mitchell Robinson undergoes pinky surgery, plans to play Game 1 of NBA Finals with brace
story_log.development: Robinson underwent surgery on broken right pinky, fully plans to play Game 1 of Finals next Wednesday wearing brace per Shams. Initially no timetable, now targeting opener. Knicks await winner of Spurs-Thunder Game 7.

story_log.title: Joao Fonseca stuns Novak Djokovic in five-set classic at French Open
story_log.development: Fonseca ousted 24-time Grand Slam champion Djokovic in five-set thriller at Roland-Garros. CBS Sports called it 'instant classic.' Men's draw now wide open. Djokovic's latest major setback.

story_log.title: Giants lose third player to torn Achilles in spring workouts
story_log.development: Giants WR/returner Gunner Olszewski tore Achilles at Friday practice, joining DL Roy Robertson-Harris and CB Thaddeus Dixon. Three torn Achilles in spring workouts. Schefter reported Olszewski carted off, additional testing to confirm.

story_log.title: MLB suspends Brewers' Abner Uribe one game for crotch-chopping toward Cardinals dugout
story_log.development: Uribe suspended for 'inappropriate' gesture toward St. Louis dugout after strikeout. Crotch-chopped after escaping bases-loaded jam. Uribe appealing. Jeff Passan reported. Three-pump rule in effect.

story_log.title: Abdul Carter and Jaxson Dart address Trump rally drama
story_log.development: Carter on Dart introducing Trump: 'If he chooses to align himself with a man like President Trump, it's my responsibility based on what I believe & what I stand on to not only show my teammates that I'm against that, but the world.' Said he doesn't want apology, wants Dart to stand on beliefs. Giants drama continues.

story_log.title: NCAA denies Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby's eligibility request after gambling rehab
story_log.development: NCAA denied Sorsby's request for reinstatement for 2026 season. Sorsby placed 40+ bets on Indiana as Hoosiers QB per report. Completed 35-day in-patient rehab. Court date June 1. Pete Thamel reported.

story_log.title: Texas survives elimination on Day 2 of Women's College World Series
story_log.development: Defending national champion Texas sent to losers' bracket after Tennessee upset, now fighting to stay alive in Oklahoma City. Day 2 action continues.

story_log.title: Saint Mary's becomes first team to upset No. 1 overall seed in regional opener
story_log.development: Saint Mary's beat No. 1 overall seed UCLA in regional opener, first time a national No. 1 seed has lost opener since national seeds introduced in 1999. Hit go-ahead homer in 9th. ESPN confirmed historic upset.

story_log.title: Four walk-off home runs hit on same night across MLB
story_log.development: Bryan Reynolds (Pirates), Miguel Vargas (White Sox), MJ Melendez (Royals), and Randy Arozarena (Rays) all hit walk-off homers. Vargas came with two outs, Sox down to final out. Incredibly rare night for walk-offs.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber extends MLB HR lead to 22 with bomb vs Dodgers
story_log.development: Schwarber hit homer in Phillies-Dodgers game, now leads MLB with 22 HR. Phillies' first hit of the game. TalkinBaseball_ called it 'Schwarbomb.'

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani crushes 10th home run of season in Dodgers win
story_log.development: Ohtani hit 10th homer of 2026 season vs Phillies. TalkinBaseball_ highlighted. Dodgers won 4-2.

story_log.title: Angel Reese posts 18-12-5 as Dream improve to 4-0 when she gets double-digit rebounds
story_log.development: Reese had 18 pts, 12 reb, 5 ast, +18 vs Portland. Atlanta is 4-0 this season when she records double-digit rebounds. StatMuse confirmed.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles leads all rookies in PPG, APG, SPG through eight games
story_log.development: Miles vs Chicago: 17 pts, 6 reb, 6 ast, 2 stl, +20. Leading all rookies in PPG (15.4), APG (5.9), and SPG (1.5). StatMuse confirmed. Lynx crushing opponents.

story_log.title: Spurs force Game 7 after dominant Game 6 win behind Wemby's 28 points
story_log.development: Game 6: San Antonio blew out Oklahoma City 118-91 to tie series 3-3. Wemby had 28 pts, 10 reb, 3 blk on 10-21 shooting. Spurs held Thunder to 13 points in third quarter. Game 7 Saturday in OKC.

story_log.title: NBA passes radical anti-tanking lottery reform with 3-2-1 system and relegation zone
story_log.development: NBA Board of Governors passed sweeping lottery reform 29-1 (Grizzlies only no vote). Expands lottery to 16 teams, creates relegation zone penalizing bottom 3 teams with reduced odds, flattens odds across board. Starts 2027 Draft. First American pro sports league to punish worst teams in draft. Memphis voted no because Utah's 2027 pick now capped at 6th.

story_log.title: MLB proposes $245M hard salary cap, $171M floor in CBA negotiations
story_log.development: MLB made first formal proposal with hard cap of $245.3M and floor of $171.2M starting in 2027. Only major North American sports league without cap. Jeff Passan broke down what it means for future of baseball. MLBPA expected to strongly oppose.

story_log.title: Knicks' Mitchell Robinson undergoes surgery on broken finger, plans to play Game 1 of Finals
story_log.development: Robinson broke right pinky finger, underwent surgery Thursday. Fully plans to play Game 1 of NBA Finals next Wednesday wearing brace per Shams. Initially no timetable for return, now targeting Finals opener.

story_log.title: Claude Lemieux, 60, dies by suicide: Four-time Stanley Cup champion won 1995 Conn Smythe Award
story_log.development: Family and NHL Alumni Association confirmed Thursday that Lemieux, four-time Stanley Cup champion and 1995 Conn Smythe winner, died by suicide at age 60. Known for tenacity and clutch playoff performances.

story_log.title: Jalen Williams active for Thunder Game 6 after missing three games with hamstring
story_log.development: OKC star Jalen Williams available for Game 6 vs Spurs after missing last three games with re-aggravated hamstring strain per Shams. Was in uniform during layup lines.

story_log.title: Federal prosecutors file new charges against Terry Rozier in gambling scheme
story_log.development: Feds allege Rozier agreed to $100k bribe to manipulate performance in NBA game as part of gambling scheme. Two new charges filed Thursday. ESPN reported.

story_log.title: Azzi Fudd posts 22 points in first career start for Dallas Wings
story_log.development: No. 1 overall pick Fudd started for first time in career Thursday vs Aces, scored 22 pts on 9-15 FG, +15 in Wings win. Undefeated as a starter.

story_log.title: Jessica Shepard posts 22-20-10 triple-double, joins elite WNBA company
story_log.development: Shepard had 22 pts, 20 reb, 10 ast on 8-13 FG vs Aces. Joins Alyssa Thomas as only players in WNBA history with 20/20/10 game. StatMuse confirmed.

story_log.title: Veronica Burton posts 25-6-5b, first guard with 25/5/5b since Taurasi in 2008
story_log.development: Burton had 25 pts, 6 reb, 5 blk vs Indiana. First guard with 25/5/5b game since Diana Taurasi in 2008. Blocked Caitlin Clark. StatMuse confirmed.

story_log.title: Women's College World Series begins with Tennessee stunning defending champ Texas

story_log.development: Acuña hit grand slam in Braves' 10-2 blowout of Red Sox. TalkinBaseball_ highlighted homer. Atlanta continues strong play.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark fastest ever to 1,000 points and 500 assists in WNBA history
story_log.development: Clark reached 1,000+ points and 500+ assists in just 59 games, fastest ever in WNBA history per ClutchPoints. Continues rewriting record books in Year 3.

story_log.title: NHL legend Claude Lemieux dies by suicide at 60
story_log.development: Family and NHL Alumni Association confirmed Wednesday that Lemieux, four-time Stanley Cup champion and 1995 Conn Smythe winner, died by suicide at age 60. ESPN and CBS Sports confirmed.

story_log.title: Spurs force Game 7 after dominant Game 6 win behind Wemby's 28 points
story_log.development: Game 6: San Antonio blew out Oklahoma City 118-91 to tie series 3-3. Wemby had 28 pts, 10 reb, 3 blk on 10-21 shooting. Spurs held Thunder to 13 points in third quarter. Game 7 Saturday in OKC.

story_log.development: Robinson broke right pinky finger, no timetable for return per Shams. Major blow to Knicks rotation entering Finals. Knicks await winner of Spurs-Thunder Game 7.

story_log.development: MLB made first formal proposal with hard cap of $245.3M and floor of $171.2M starting in 2027. Only major North American sports league without cap. Jeff Passan broke down what it means for future of baseball. MLBPA expected to strongly oppose.

story_log.title: Federal prosecutors file new charges against Terry Rozier in gambling scheme
story_log.development: Feds allege Rozier agreed to $100k bribe to manipulate performance in NBA game as part of gambling scheme. Two new charges filed Thursday. ESPN reported.

story_log.title: Jalen Williams active for Thunder Game 6 after missing three games with hamstring
story_log.development: OKC star Jalen Williams available for Game 6 vs Spurs after missing last three games with re-aggravated hamstring strain per Shams. Was in uniform during layup lines.

story_log.title: Azzi Fudd makes first career start for Dallas Wings, drops 22 points
story_log.development: No. 1 overall pick Fudd started for first time in career Thursday vs Aces, scored 22 pts on 9-15 FG. Wings beat defending champion Aces. Fudd averaging 24 ppg off bench vs New York last game.

story_log.development: Shepard had 22 pts, 20 reb, 10 ast on 8-13 FG vs Aces. Joins Alyssa Thomas as only players in WNBA history with 20/20/10 game. StatMuse confirmed.

story_log.development: Carolina won Game 4 at home 4-0 behind Frederik Andersen's 18-save shutout to take commanding 3-1 series lead. Hurricanes one win from Stanley Cup Finals. Andersen has won 11 of 12 games this postseason.

story_log.development: Agent's Take column projects Eagles and Brown are 'headed for a split.' Hurts addressed media at OTAs Wednesday, said relationship with Brown is 'really good' despite ongoing trade speculation.

story_log.title: Cristopher Sánchez extends scoreless streak to 44.2 innings, breaks 115-year-old Phillies record
story_log.development: Sánchez did not allow a run in all of May, extending scoreless streak to 44.2 innings (seventh-longest in MLB since 1920). Broke Phillies club record that stood for 115 years. ERA now 1.47, shutout streak intact after Wednesday start vs Padres.

story_log.title: Munetaka Murakami first to 20 homers as White Sox beat Twins 15-2
story_log.development: White Sox rookie Murakami became first player in MLB to 20 home runs this season in Chicago's 15-2 blowout of Twins. Has more than next two Japanese players combined (Okamoto 11, Ohtani 8). Also first rookie to 20, ahead of Sal Stewart (12).

story_log.title: Travis Kelce joins Guardians ownership group as minority investor
story_log.development: Chiefs tight end Kelce purchased minority stake in Cleveland Guardians, team he grew up watching. Told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Wednesday. Joining ownership group while still active NFL player.

story_log.title: Underdog Sports receives cease and desist over 'Unethical Hoops' promotion mocking SGA flopping
story_log.development: Underdog received cease and desist letter regarding promotion called 'Unethical Hoops' that made fun of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's efforts to draw fouls per The Athletic. SGA has 120 FTM vs 114 FGM in 2026 playoffs.

story_log.title: NBA warns Wembanyama for skipping media obligations after Game 5 loss
story_log.development: NBA warned Spurs' Victor Wembanyama for violating media access rules after he bypassed media obligations following Game 5 on Tuesday night per Shams. Wemby had 26 pts but only 1 reb in second half as Spurs lost to fall behind 2-1.

story_log.title: Josh Jacobs released from jail, no charges filed yet after domestic violence arrest
story_log.development: Packers RB Jacobs released from jail Wednesday after arrest on domestic violence charges. No charges filed at this time. Brown County DA says investigation 'remains open and ongoing,' requested additional investigation.

story_log.title: Iowa State's Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA Draft, enters transfer portal
story_log.development: Momcilovic withdrew from 2026 NBA Draft and will return to college. Kentucky, Louisville, Arizona, and St. John's pursuing. Made 136 threes last season at Iowa State, best shooter in the country. Massive bidding war emerging.

story_log.title: Matthew Stafford contract details: rolling guarantees, decision points through 2028
story_log.development: Pelissero reported contract details: $40M in 2026, $45M base in 2027 with $5M roster bonus becomes fully guaranteed if on roster mid-March 2027. $100M dummy year in 2029 creates decision point for 2028. Can earn $5M incentives each year (NFC title win, SB win with 70% playtime).

story_log.title: MLBPA makes first CBA proposal: $150M competitive integrity tax, $1.5M minimum salary
story_log.development: Union's first proposal includes 'competitive integrity tax' for teams not spending $150M, minimum salary increase from $780k to $1.5M, base CBT threshold increase from $244M to $300M. Free agency for 30-year-olds at 5+ years service. Expanded revenue sharing. MLB expected to counter with salary cap proposal.

story_log.title: Gunnar Henderson's two-homer game powers Orioles to sweep of Rays
story_log.development: Henderson went 2-4 with 2 HR and 4 RBI in Baltimore's 11-2 blowout of Tampa Bay to complete sweep. His first multi-homer game since 2024. Orioles swept AL-leading Rays.

story_log.title: Yordan Alvarez reaches 20 homers with back-to-back multi-homer games
story_log.development: Alvarez homered twice in consecutive games, reaching 20 HR on season (tied for AL lead). Had four home runs over two-game span. OPS was dangerously close to dropping below 1.000 so he heated back up in a hurry per CespedesBBQ.

story_log.title: Knicks sweep Cavaliers 4-0 to reach NBA Finals for first time since 1999
story_log.development: New York completed sweep of Cleveland 109-93 at MSG to reach first NBA Finals in 27 years. Brunson 29-8 assists, KAT 19-14 reb, Landry Shamet 16 pts on 4-4 from three (12-13 from three all series). Knicks won 11 straight playoff games, outscored opponents by 262 pts across that run (best 11-game differential in NBA history). Cleveland swept for first time since LeBron era. Series ended with James Harden saying Cavs are 'better team.'

story_log.title: Knicks advance to NBA Finals for first time since 1999, await Thunder-Spurs winner
story_log.development: New York reached NBA Finals for first time in 27 years after sweeping Cavs. Brunson wins ECF MVP. Knicks have won 11 straight playoff games, largest postseason point differential in NBA history. Will face winner of Thunder-Spurs WCF (tied 2-2). Celebration massive in NYC, Ben Stiller emotional, Timothée Chalamet in tears courtside. Tracy Morgan crying. Mayor Zohran Mamdani trolls Cavs.

story_log.title: Kenny Atkinson returning as Cavs coach despite sweep, analytics comments backlash
story_log.development: Cavs confirmed Atkinson will return for third season despite sweep and 'analytically winning' comments that drew internet ridicule and reportedly upset front office. Shams and ESPN reported decision. James Harden postgame: 'We're the better team.' Windhorst floats Giannis trade possibility.

story_log.title: Hurricanes take 2-1 series lead over Canadiens after Game 3 win
story_log.development: Carolina won Game 3 6-2 at home to take 2-1 series lead over Montreal. Hurricanes bounce back from Game 2 OT loss. Series shifts to Montreal for Game 4 tonight.

story_log.title: Thunder-Spurs WCF tied 2-2, Game 5 tonight in OKC as Jalen Williams questionable
story_log.development: Series tied 2-2 after Wemby's 33-point Game 4 masterpiece (including halfcourt buzzer beater) evened things up. Game 5 tonight in Oklahoma City. Jalen Williams listed as questionable again (left hamstring now 'strain' instead of 'soreness'). Ajay Mitchell out again. Scott Foster not assigned to Game 5.

story_log.title: Golden Knights one win from Stanley Cup Finals after taking 3-0 lead on Avalanche
story_log.development: Vegas can close out Colorado tonight in Game 4 after taking 3-0 series lead. MacKinnon will play despite puck to knee in Game 3. Knights completed historic 3-goal comeback in Game 3 (Avs were 74-1 when leading by 3+). Mark Stone and Cale Makar both returned from injuries in Game 3.

story_log.title: USMNT announces 26-man World Cup roster: Pulisic, Adams, McKennie lead squad; Diego Luna snubbed
story_log.development: Mauricio Pochettino announced USMNT's 26-man World Cup roster after leaks. Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Weston McKennie headline. Gio Reyna made squad despite 2022 drama. Diego Luna left off despite strong club form. Cristian Roldan inclusion criticized. Ten defenders named. England also announced squad with Trent Alexander-Arnold, Phil Foden, Cole Palmer all snubbed; Ivan Toney made cut.

story_log.title: Manny Fernandez, anchor of 1972 undefeated Dolphins' No-Name Defense, dies at 79
story_log.development: Fernandez, two-time Super Bowl champion and defensive lineman on Miami's legendary 1972 undefeated team, died at age 79. Dolphins announced Tuesday. Part of iconic No-Name Defense.

story_log.title: Matthew Stafford officially signs 1-year, $55M extension with Rams through 2027
story_log.development: Stafford officially signed extension Tuesday worth $55M (up to $60M with incentives). Reigning MVP at 38 now tied to LA through 2027 with $105M remaining. Brought family to signing. Betting on two more years after MVP season.

story_log.title: Texans guarantee Nico Collins' next two years, add $17M cash in adjusted deal
story_log.development: Pro-Bowl WR Nico Collins and Texans reached agreement on adjusted contract that guarantees his salary the next two seasons, includes $9M cash increase this year and $8M increase next year per Drew and Jason Rosenhaus. Schefter reported. Collins remains under contract through 2027.

story_log.title: Astros throw combined no-hitter vs Rangers, first MLB no-no since 2024
story_log.development: Tatsuya Imai (6 IP), Steven Okert, and Alimber Santa (MLB debut) combined to no-hit Rangers 9-0. First no-hitter in MLB since 2024 season. Santa becomes second player ever to pitch in no-hitter in MLB debut (Bumpus Jones 1892 threw solo no-no). Combined no-hitters still don't belong in record books per Snyder's Soapbox.

story_log.title: Bob Horner, 1978 No. 1 overall pick who skipped minors entirely, dies at 68
story_log.development: Horner, star at Arizona State and first overall pick in 1978 MLB Draft who went straight to majors, died at 68. Braves slugger 'built a career out of being first.' CBS Sports reported.

story_log.title: Wander Franco found criminally responsible for sexual abuse of minor, no jail time served
story_log.development: Tampa Bay Rays shortstop declared criminally responsible for sexual and psychological abuse of a minor, but will not serve sentence. Dominican Republic judge ruled Monday. Full sentencing slated for June 16. Franco will not go to jail.

story_log.title: Supreme Court allows Brian Flores discrimination lawsuit vs NFL to proceed to trial
story_log.development: Supreme Court refused to intervene in discrimination lawsuit led by former Dolphins coach Brian Flores against NFL, allowing case to proceed toward trial. NFL had hoped to handle case through arbitration. Court decision allows it to move forward.

story_log.title: NCAA denies Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby's eligibility request after gambling rehab
story_log.development: NCAA denied Sorsby's request for reinstatement for 2026 season. Sorsby completed 35-day in-patient rehab for gambling addiction at Algamus in Goodyear, Arizona. Will return to campus in upcoming days. Court date June 1 in Lubbock County. PeteThamel reported.

story_log.title: Evgeni Malkin returning to Penguins for 21st season on 1-year, $5.5M deal
story_log.development: Penguins center Malkin signed one-year deal worth $5.5 million, team announced Tuesday. Will return for 21st NHL season. Three-time Stanley Cup champion continues career in Pittsburgh.

story_log.title: Victor Wembanyama's 1-of-1 Prizm Black card sells for $5.11 million in private sale
story_log.development: Wembanyama's 1-of-1 numbered 2023-24 Panini Prizm Black parallel sold for $5.11 million in private sale via Fanatics Collect. Fanatics confirmed to ESPN. Record-breaking card sale for second-year player.

story_log.title: Don Rea Jr. out as PGA of America president after Ryder Cup fan behavior controversy
story_log.development: Rea, who came under fire for delayed response to unruly fan behavior directed at European Ryder Cup team, is out as president of PGA of America. PGA continues shaking up leadership after tumultuous Ryder Cup.

story_log.title: Ketel Marte's scorching 3-game stretch: 10 H, 3 2B, 8 RBI, 6 RBI in one game
story_log.development: Marte over last three games: 10 hits, 3 doubles, 8 RBI, 6 RBI in one game. Only one other player has put up those numbers in 3-game span in last 8 seasons: Nick Kurtz in 2025. StatMuse noted. Marte heating up after slow start.

story_log.title: Rays sign veteran closer Craig Kimbrel to shore up bullpen
story_log.development: Tampa Bay signed right-handed reliever Craig Kimbrel to major league contract Tuesday. Move to shore up bullpen. Ken Rosenthal reported. Kimbrel gets another chance in AL East.

story_log.development: San Antonio evened series 2-2 with 103-82 blowout win behind Wemby's 33 pts (11-22 FG), 8 reb, 5 ast, 3 blk including halfcourt buzzer beater to end first half. Spurs' defense shut down Thunder completely: OKC shot 2-14 from three, Spurs +9 turnover pts, +11 FT margin. Stephon Castle 13-6 ast. Series returns to OKC for Game 5 tied 2-2.

story_log.development: Vegas trailed 3-0 after first period in Game 3, then scored 5 unanswered (3 in final 10 minutes) to win 5-3. Mark Stone and Cale Makar both returned from injuries. story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: New York won Game 3 in Cleveland 121-108 to take commanding 3-0 series lead. Brunson 35-3, Bridges 22-6, OG 21-7. story_log.development: Cavs coach said Cleveland is 'analytically' winning series vs Knicks despite being down 0-3. Added: 'No one wants to hear that.' CBS Sports headline called it verge-of-being-swept delusion. Internet roasting Atkinson for leaning on analytics while facing elimination.

story_log.development: Messi left Inter Miami's high-scoring thriller vs Philadelphia Union with apparent hamstring injury, went straight to tunnel. World Cup begins in June. Argentina superstar's fitness now in question ahead of tournament. CBS Sports reporting injury sparking major concern.

story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Chicago's losing streak reached 8 games after Astros swept them at Wrigley 8-5 on Sunday. story_log.development: Devers crushed opposite-field grand slam in 8th inning to give Giants lead over Dodgers. First Giant with 5-RBI game this season. Devers now SF's power threat. Drew Gilbert's postgame thrust celebration so powerful it knocked out both outfielders behind him.

story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Dodgers utility player Chris Taylor officially announced retirement after 12-year career. Confirmed decision postgame Sunday. End of career for longtime Dodgers contributor and 2020 World Series champion.

story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Dodgers' Hernandez hit walk-off grand slam off Brewers closer Devin Williams in dramatic Sunday finish. Jake Burger also homered earlier. Jimmy Knorp knows ball.

story_log.development: Minnesota swept Boston at Fenway Park, winning 6-5 after throwing out tying run at home plate in 9th inning. Red Sox challenged for blocking plate, call confirmed. Twins take series in hostile environment.

story_log.title: Heriberto Hernandez walk-off grand slam off Devin Williams stuns Brewers
story_log.development: Dodgers' Hernandez hit walk-off grand slam off Brewers closer Devin Williams. Dramatic finish to Sunday game.

story_log.title: Curt Cignetti drives Indy 500 pace car with Blackhawk helicopters in pursuit
story_log.development: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti drove pace car at Indianapolis 500. Video showed Blackhawk helicopters chasing him. Pat McAfee and internet reacted to spectacle. Cignetti wore his 2024-25 CFP quarter zip (internet convinced he'll be buried in it). Cignetti postgame: 'Rear view mirror was disabled.'

story_log.title: Georgia wins first SEC baseball tournament championship in program history
story_log.development: Georgia beat someone to capture first SEC tournament title in program history. Kenny Ishikawa's celebration went viral. Historic moment for Bulldogs baseball.

story_log.title: Northwestern women's lacrosse rallies from 11-9 deficit to beat UNC in national championship
story_log.development: Northwestern trailed UNC 11-9 entering 4th quarter of women's lacrosse national title game, then shut out Tar Heels 5-0 in final frame to win championship. Incredible comeback performance.

story_log.title: Knicks take 3-0 stranglehold on Cavs with dominant road win, one win from Finals
story_log.development: New York won Game 3 in Cleveland 121-108 to take commanding 3-0 series lead. Brunson had 35-3, Mikal Bridges 22-6, OG 21-7. Knicks have won 10 straight playoff games, largest postseason point differential since 1970 (+234). No team has ever come back from 0-3. Knicks one win from first Finals since 1999.

story_log.title: Canadiens tie series 1-1 after Ehlers' OT winner stuns Hurricanes at home
story_log.development: Montreal won Game 2 in Raleigh 3-2 in OT. Nikolaj Ehlers scored twice including OT winner to even series. Carolina had taken Game 1 by 6-2 margin but Habs bounce back to tie it up. Series shifts to Montreal for Game 3.

story_log.title: Scott Foster named crew chief for Thunder-Spurs Game 4 after OKC takes 2-1 lead
story_log.development: NBA activated 'Series Extender' protocol: Scott Foster will officiate Thunder-Spurs Game 4 on Sunday with OKC leading 2-1. Internet immediately reacts to Foster assignment, expecting Game 4 to go San Antonio's way. The NBA's most notorious referee gets the call.

story_log.title: Abdul Carter clears air with Jaxson Dart after QB introduced Trump at rally
story_log.development: Giants QB Jaxson Dart introduced President Trump at rally, drawing criticism. Teammate Abdul Carter initially sacked him publicly on social media. Both later said they're 'good' and 'spoke as men.' John Harbaugh (per BallsackSports satire) says Carter needs to apologize to locker room. Internet jokes Giants season over before it started. Drama in year one of Harbaugh era.

story_log.title: Lance Stephenson submits Michael Beasley in first round of MMA fight
story_log.development: Two former NBA teammates faced off in MMA fight. Lance submitted Beasley seconds into first round with rear naked choke. This came after Beasley beat Lance in 2025 TNC 1-on-1 basketball PPV for $100k. Their rivalry now spans basketball, 1v1 battles, and MMA.

story_log.title: Johnny Manziel knocks out Bob Menery in first round of MMA fight, announces retirement
story_log.development: Former Heisman winner Manziel 'beat the brakes off' Bob Menery in first round, finishing via KO. Manziel announced retirement from MMA immediately after, ending his career at 1-0. Going out on top.

story_log.title: Supah Hot Fire knocks out Ray J in celebrity MMA fight
story_log.development: Internet personality Supah Hot Fire knocked out Ray J in first round. Video shows Ray J's eyes glazed over after KO, 'heard them saxophones.' Wild celebrity MMA night continues.

story_log.title: Kelsey Plum drops 38-9 against former team as Sparks upset Aces
story_log.development: Plum torched her former team with 38 pts, 9 ast on 12-17 FG in Sparks' 101-95 win over defending champion Aces. First 35+ pts, 5+ ast, 5+ 3PT game of her career. Averaging 32.5 ppg against Vegas this season. A'ja had 24-15-4b but it wasn't enough.

story_log.title: Travis Kelce chugs beer on jumbotron while Taylor Swift reacts at Cavs-Knicks Game 3
story_log.development: Kelce and Swift attended Game 3 courtside in Cleveland. Kelce chugged beer on jumbotron, cameras showed Taylor's reaction. W_B_Rick: 'Taylor might be first person to voluntarily become Cavs fan since LeBron left.' Broadcast kept showing Travis, barely mentioned Taylor.

story_log.title: Mike Trout homers in first inning for fourth straight game
story_log.development: Trout hit two-run blast in 1st inning vs Rangers on Sunday Night Baseball. Angels have now homered in first inning in four consecutive games. Angels look to sweep Texas for first time since 2022.

story_log.title: Elly De La Cruz goes opposite field for 3-run homer, Reds walk off Cardinals in 11th
story_log.development: Elly hit three-run homer the other way to give Reds lead. Jordan Walker tied it with two outs in 9th for Cards, but Reds walked it off in 11th inning. Elly now has just 3 homers in last 24 games after hot start.

story_log.title: Stephen Kolek throws complete game with just 2 strikeouts, third pitcher to do it this decade
story_log.development: Padres pitcher Kolek completed game with only 2 SO, joining Reid Detmers (2022) and Brad Keller (2020) as only pitchers this decade to do it. Rare throwback complete game performance.

story_log.title: Bills begin demolishing old stadium as new Highmark Stadium nears completion
story_log.development: With new Highmark Stadium on track to be ready for upcoming season, Bills have begun demolishing their old stadium piece by piece. Process expected to last into 2027. End of an era in Buffalo.

story_log.title: Bruno Fernandes breaks Premier League single-season assist record on final day
story_log.development: Manchester United midfielder set new Premier League record for most assists in a season on Matchday 38. Arsenal already crowned champions, but Bruno got his individual record on final day.

story_log.title: NASCAR legend Kyle Busch dies at 41 after pneumonia complications
story_log.development: Family released statement Friday: Busch died after severe pneumonia progressed into sepsis. 911 call obtained by AP revealed he experienced shortness of breath, felt overheating, and was coughing up blood day before death. Two-time Cup Series champion, one of NASCAR's all-time greats.

story_log.title: Thunder erase 15-0 deficit, take 2-1 series lead behind 71 bench points
story_log.development: OKC erased early 15-0 hole to win Game 3 in San Antonio 123-108. Thunder bench outscored Spurs' bench 71-18 (53-point margin, most in a CF/Finals game since 1971). Jared McCain exploded for 24 points off the bench (playoff career-high), Jaylin Williams added 18 on 5-6 from three in 21 minutes. SGA had 26-12 assists. Wemby posted 26 pts but only 1 rebound in second half. Jalen Williams ruled out before game (hamstring). Series shifts back to OKC for Game 4.

story_log.title: Golden Knights take 2-0 stranglehold after comeback in Colorado
story_log.development: Vegas rallied from 1-0 deficit late in Game 2, scored twice in final 2:14 (Barbashev bar-down, Eichel first goal in 10 games) to win 3-1 in Denver. Colorado was 45-0-0 when leading after 2 periods, now 45-1-0. Only 1945 Red Wings have won NHL best-of-7 semifinal after losing first two at home. Knights take commanding 2-0 lead back to Vegas for Game 3.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole dominates in return: 6 IP, 0 R, hits 98.6 mph after 569 days
story_log.development: Cole threw 6 shutout innings (2 H, 3 BB, 2 SO) vs Rays in first MLB start since Tommy John surgery 569 days ago. Hit 98.6 mph on fastball. Yankees won 4-2 behind Rays bullpen implosion. Cole looked sharp, rotation finally gets ace back.

story_log.title: Jared McCain's 24-point breakout fuels Thunder comeback, Sixers roasted
story_log.development: McCain exploded for 24 points on 10-21 FG in Game 3, playoff career-high. Daryl Morey said in February 'I'm quite confident we were selling high' on McCain trade. Three months later McCain is dominating in WCF. Postgame: 'I love what my life is right now... I never want to take it for granted.' Internet roasting Sixers. StatMuse: McCain made more shots than both MVP finalists.

story_log.title: Spurs fans chant 'FLOPPER' at SGA, he says 'it does nothing'
story_log.development: Entire Spurs arena chanted 'FLOPPER' at SGA during Game 3. Spurs fan dressed as SGA in bubble wrap yelling 'TWO SHOTS! THAT'S A FOUL!' SGA postgame: 'It does nothing. Doesn't fuel me, doesn't discourage me. I've been dealing with it for a long time. I honestly like it. It makes the game more interesting.' Internet reaction viral. Lu Dort also dove into De'Aaron Fox's ankle, scuffle broke out, Isaiah Joe faked leaving bench and laughed at coaches.

story_log.title: Southern Miss hits walk-off grand slam down 3 with 2 outs, 0-2 count — then brawl
story_log.development: Drey Barrett hit walk-off grand slam in bottom of 9th down 3 runs, two outs, 0-2 count in conference tournament. Every backyard dream. Then #35 bumped Troy catcher, #32 came to defense, benches cleared. Peak college baseball chaos captured by Jomboy.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark drops 22-9 in return after back soreness scratch
story_log.development: Clark, who missed first game of season Wednesday due to back soreness, returned Friday vs Valkyries with 22 pts, 9 ast, 4 threes. Said returning from 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge.' Fever are 2-0. Leading league in APG with 9.

story_log.title: Si Woo Kim bogeys 18th to shoot 60 after flirting with 59 at Byron Nelson
story_log.development: Kim went bogey-free until final hole of round. Needed par on 18th to shoot 16th sub-60 round in PGA Tour history. Bogeyed to shoot 60. Still took five-shot lead into weekend. Scheffler and Spieth in hunt.

story_log.title: Mississippi State rallies from 4 down to stun Oklahoma in Norman, snaps Sooners' 18-game Super Regional streak
story_log.development: Since 2000, Oklahoma softball was 77-0 when leading by 4+ in Regional/Super Regional. Now 77-1 after Mississippi State rallied in Norman to end OU's 18-game Supers win streak. Oklahoma had led 6-2. MSU scored 9 runs in final two innings to win Game 1 in stunning fashion. Tennessee punched first WCWS ticket by sweeping Georgia.

story_log.title: Oliver McBurnie's 95th-minute goal sends Hull City to Premier League
story_log.development: McBurnie scored in 95th minute of Championship playoff final to beat Middlesbrough, sends Hull to Premier League. Tigers return to English first division. Middlesbrough got lifeline after Southampton's shock spygate disqualification but couldn't capitalize.

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards on Wemby ejection: 'I was so happy that n***a got kicked out'
story_log.development: Edwards on when Wembanyama got ejected for elbowing Naz Reid: 'That n**** like 8'5... The rim aint nothing but 10 feet... I was so happy that n**** got kicked out... I hope they suspend him. Imma email they ass right now!' Hilarious reaction from Ant captured on his YouTube channel.

story_log.title: Daryl Morey says he was using ChatGPT during Jared McCain trade negotiations before service crashed
story_log.development: NBA Centel reporting Morey admitted he was using ChatGPT during McCain trade negotiations before service crashed. Would explain a lot about how that deal went down. Internet roasting Sixers again after McCain's 24-point WCF performance.

story_log.title: Thunder take 2-1 series lead after erasing early 15-0 deficit behind monster bench performance
story_log.development: OKC erased early 15-0 hole to win Game 3 in San Antonio 123-108. Thunder bench outscored Spurs' bench 71-18 (53-point margin). Jared McCain exploded for 24 points off the bench (playoff career high), Jaylin Williams added 18 points on 5-6 from three in 21 minutes. SGA had 26-12 assists, 12-of-12 FT. Wemby posted 26 pts but only 1 rebound in second half. Series shifts back to OKC for Game 4 with defending champs now one win from Finals.

story_log.title: Golden Knights take 2-0 stranglehold on Avalanche after rallying late in Colorado
story_log.development: Vegas rallied from 1-0 deficit late in Game 2, scored twice in final 2:14 to win 3-1 in Denver. Ivan Barbashev scored go-ahead goal bar-down, Jack Eichel added insurance (first goal in 10 games). Colorado was 45-0-0 this season when leading after 2 periods, now 45-1-0. Only the 1945 Red Wings have ever won an NHL best-of-7 semifinal series after losing first two at home. Knights take commanding 2-0 lead back to Vegas.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole dominates in return from 569-day layoff: 6 IP, 0 R, hits 98.6 mph
story_log.development: Cole threw 6 shutout innings with 2 hits, 3 walks, 2 strikeouts vs Rays in first MLB start since Tommy John surgery 569 days ago. Hit 98.6 mph on fastball. Yankees won 4-2 behind Rays bullpen implosion. Cole looked sharp, Yankees rotation finally gets their ace back.

story_log.title: Kyle Manzardo pinch-hit homer breaks scoreless tie, lifts Guardians past Phillies in 9th
story_log.development: Gavin Williams threw 8 scoreless innings with 11 strikeouts, matched by Phillies ace Cristopher Sanchez. Game stayed 0-0 until Manzardo delivered pinch-hit homer in 9th to give Cleveland 1-0 win. Williams is first Guardians pitcher with 8+ IP and 11+ SO in a start since Triston McKenzie in 2022. Elite pitching showcase ends with clutch pinch-hit drama.

story_log.title: Jared McCain posts playoff career-high 24 points off bench, fuels Thunder comeback
story_log.development: McCain exploded for 24 points on 10-21 FG in Game 3, playoff career high. Daryl Morey said in February 'I'm quite confident we were selling high' on McCain trade to OKC. Three months later McCain is dropping 24 in WCF to help Thunder take 2-1 series lead. Internet roasting Sixers for trading him. McCain postgame: 'I love what my life is right now.'

story_log.title: Spurs fans chant 'FLOPPER' at SGA as tensions rise in physical Game 3
story_log.development: Entire Spurs arena chanted 'FLOPPER' at Shai Gilgeous-Alexander during Game 3. SGA postgame: 'It does nothing. Doesn't fuel me, doesn't discourage me. I've been dealing with it for a long time.' Spurs fan dressed as SGA in bubble wrap yelling 'TWO SHOTS! THAT'S A FOUL!' Also: Lu Dort dove into De'Aaron Fox's previously injured ankle, Fox left game holding ankle. Scuffle broke out, Isaiah Joe faked like he'd leave bench and laughed at coaches. Series getting chippy.

story_log.title: Southern Miss hits walk-off grand slam down 3 with 2 outs, 0-2 count — then brawl breaks out
story_log.development: Southern Miss' Drey Barrett hit walk-off grand slam in bottom of 9th down 3 runs, two outs, 0-2 count in conference tournament. Every baseball kid's backyard dream. Then #35 bumped Troy catcher, #32 came to catcher's defense, benches cleared. Peak college baseball chaos.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark says coming back from 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge'
story_log.development: Clark, who missed first game of season Wednesday due to back soreness, acknowledged that returning from her 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge.' Dropped 22-9-4 in return vs Valkyries. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Year 3 off to strong start despite lingering injury concerns.

story_log.title: Giants DL Roy Robertson-Harris tears Achilles at OTAs, out for 2026 season
story_log.development: Robertson-Harris tore his Achilles tendon at Thursday's OTA workout and is expected to miss entire 2026 season. Significant blow to Giants defensive line depth in year one under John Harbaugh.

story_log.title: Matthew Stafford and Rams finalize 1-year, $55M extension through 2027
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Stafford officially signed one-year, $55M extension (up to $60M with incentives). Now tied to LA through 2027 season with $105M remaining. Brought family to sign contract. Reigning MVP at 38 betting on two more years.

story_log.title: Lions extend All-Pro LB Jack Campbell through 2030 on 4-year, $81M deal
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Detroit signed Campbell to four-year extension through 2030 worth $81M with $51.5M guaranteed per Ian Rapoport. First player from Lions' 2023 draft class to get extended. Team locking in core after deep playoff runs.

story_log.title: Eagles LB Nolan Smith arrested for speeding at 135 mph in 70 mph zone
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Smith arrested Friday in Georgia on speeding and reckless driving charges after car clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone. Second-year LB facing serious charges entering 2026 season.

story_log.title: Si Woo Kim bogeys 18th to shoot 60 after flirting with 59 at Byron Nelson
story_log.development: Kim went bogey-free until final hole of round at CJ Cup Byron Nelson. Needed par on 18th to shoot 16th sub-60 round in PGA Tour history. Bogeyed to shoot 60. Still took five-shot lead into the weekend. Scheffler and Spieth in the hunt.

story_log.title: Tarps Off movement spreads nationwide as crews hit Oracle Park, Milwaukee, Kansas City
story_log.development: Tarps Off crews showed up at multiple stadiums Friday night: Oracle Park (Giants down five), Milwaukee, Kansas City (got usher to join in). Movement going national. Jomboy Media documenting the spread.

story_log.title: Chadwick Tromp walks off Nationals in 11th as Braves keep finding ways to win
story_log.development: Tromp hit walk-off single in 11th inning to give Braves 5-4 win over Nationals. Atlanta continues to scratch out wins every single night. 30-13 record, best in MLB.

story_log.title: Former Wisconsin guard John Blackwell withdraws from NBA Draft, transfers to Duke
story_log.development: Blackwell withdrew from 2026 NBA Draft to transfer to Duke for senior year. Averaged 19.1 ppg for Wisconsin last season. Major pickup for Coach K's Blue Devils. Rothstein and Haynes both reported.

story_log.title: NCAA opened Ole Miss investigation same day Dabo Swinney accused Pete Golding of tampering
story_log.development: NCAA enforcement staff opened investigation of Ole Miss football program the same day Clemson coach Dabo Swinney publicly accused Rebels coach Pete Golding of tampering with LB Luke Ferrelli. Timing raises questions about whether Dabo complaint triggered probe.

story_log.title: Ed Orgeron returns to LSU as assistant under Lane Kiffin, seven years after national title
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Coach O hired as special assistant to recruiting and defense at LSU under new coach Lane Kiffin. Decades-long friendship between the two. Pardon My Take aired interview with both at LSU facilities. Orgeron on Brian Kelly's 'faaaaymly' introduction: discussed on PMT.

story_log.title: Pep Guardiola confirms he is leaving Manchester City at end of season after 10 years
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Guardiola officially confirmed he will leave City at end of season after nearly a decade of dominance. Won 16 major trophies including multiple Premier League titles. Michael Carrick named permanent manager at Man United. Premier League changing forever.

story_log.title: NASCAR legend Kyle Busch dies at 41
story_log.development: Two-time Cup Series champion Kyle Busch died at age 41 after illness. NASCAR community mourns loss of all-time great and fierce competitor.

story_log.title: Knicks take 2-0 stranglehold on Cavs behind Josh Hart's career playoff high
story_log.development: New York won Game 2 109-93 at MSG behind Josh Hart's playoff career-high 26 points on 5-of-11 from three. Cavs dared Hart to shoot, he buried them. Brunson had 19-14 assists (most by Knick in playoff game since 1998). Knicks have won 9 straight playoff games, take 2-0 series lead to Cleveland.

story_log.title: Canadiens hand Hurricanes first playoff loss with 6-2 statement win
story_log.development: Montreal won Game 1 of ECF 6-2 in Raleigh, ending Carolina's 8-0 playoff run. Canadiens scored 6 goals in Game 1 — more than Hurricanes allowed in entire Ottawa series (5 total). Juraj Slafkovsky had 2 goals, 3 points.

story_log.title: Rams extend reigning MVP Matthew Stafford with $55M deal for 2026 season
story_log.development: Stafford and Rams agreed to 1-year, $55M extension (up to $60M with incentives) keeping 38-year-old QB through 2027. Comes weeks after Rams drafted Ty Simpson at No. 13. Stafford won MVP in 2025, led Rams to Super Bowl in 2021. Now two years, $105M remaining on deal.

story_log.title: Tuchel snubs Trent Alexander-Arnold, Phil Foden, and Cole Palmer from England World Cup squad
story_log.development: England announced 26-man World Cup roster with massive surprises: Trent Alexander-Arnold, Phil Foden, and Cole Palmer all left off squad. Ivan Toney made the cut. Tuchel's bold selections spark controversy weeks before tournament.

story_log.title: Giants extend GM Joe Schoen to multi-year deal alongside John Harbaugh
story_log.development: New York signed GM Schoen to multi-year extension, securing front office continuity with new head coach John Harbaugh. Schoen delivered mixed results on first contract but ownership committed to pairing.

story_log.title: Lions lock up All-Pro LB Jack Campbell with 4-year extension
story_log.development: Detroit signed All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell to four-year extension through 2030 season. First player from Lions' 2023 draft class to get extended. Deals for Gibbs, LaPorta, and Branch expected to follow.

story_log.title: WNBA issues Fever warning for leaving Caitlin Clark off injury report
story_log.development: League fined and warned Indiana for late scratch controversy after Clark was left off injury report before game. Clark officially listed as probable for Friday's game vs Valkyries.

story_log.title: Blue Jays blank Yankees 2-0 as Bombers go ice cold
story_log.development: Toronto shut out Yankees 2-0. New York's offense in last 2 games: 9-for-62 (.145 AVG), 0 HR, 1 run. StatMuse notes Yankees have fewest games (9) vs teams above .500, are 1-8 in those games.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll walks it off for Diamondbacks in 10th inning
story_log.development: Carroll hit walk-off line drive in extras to give Arizona 2-1 win over Rockies. A's also won in extras after overturned call at first base gave them 10th-inning lead.

story_log.title: Josh Hart destroys analytics: 'They're lamp posts to a drunk person'
story_log.development: Hart on analytics after career playoff night: 'They're lamp posts to a drunk person. You can lean on them, but it won't get you home.' KAT couldn't believe he said it. Hart also pulled up to presser eating pizza.

story_log.title: NFLPA makes JAMs the exclusive PB&J sandwich of the Players Association
story_log.development: NFLPA reached agreement with JAMs (co-owned by JJ Watt and Caleb Williams) to become exclusive peanut butter-and-jelly sandwich provider league-wide this season. Schefter broke the massive news.

story_log.title: Golden State Valkyries beat Liberty 87-70 in franchise debut
story_log.development: Valkyries won first game in franchise history, beating defending champion Liberty 87-70. Dearica Hamby had 27-15-7 on 7-11 FG for Sparks in separate game.

story_log.title: Thunder tie series 1-1 behind SGA's bounce-back 30-bomb and Isaiah Hartenstein's physicality on Wemby
story_log.development: OKC evened series at 1-1 with dominant home win behind SGA's 30-9-2 and only 1 turnover. Isaiah Hartenstein played entire 4th quarter (10 pts, 13 reb, 8 OREB) bodying Wemby who finished with 21-17-6-4b but just 4 points in the 4th. Spurs lost Dylan Harper to right leg injury in 2nd half, adding to De'Aaron Fox absence. Thunder forced 21 turnovers including Stephon Castle's 9 (20 total over first two games, most in CF history). Alex Caruso added 17-5 off bench. Jalen Williams (hamstring tightness) didn't return after first half.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle sets conference finals record with 20 turnovers through two games, still delivers 25-5-8 in Game 2
story_log.development: Castle committed 9 turnovers in Game 2 (11 in Game 1), setting CF record for most turnovers through first two games (20) in NBA history. Despite turnover issues, still posted 25 points, 5 rebounds, 8 assists. At 21, became youngest player ever with 30-10-5-5 in playoffs (Game 1) and youngest with 25-5-8 in CF game.

story_log.title: Golden Knights steal Game 1 in Colorado as Avalanche play without Cale Makar
story_log.development: Vegas took Game 1 of WCF 4-2 in Denver despite Avalanche playing without Cale Makar (day-to-day injury). Dylan Coghlan scored first career playoff goal, Carter Hart made 36 saves, Mitch Marner fed Pavel Dorofeyev for insurance goal. Valeri Nichushkin scored between-the-legs goal for Colorado. Series shifts to Vegas for Game 2.

story_log.title: Aaron Rodgers confirms he will retire after 2026 season, ending 22-year career
story_log.development: Rodgers officially announced 2026 will be his final NFL season at Steelers OTAs. 'This is it,' he told reporters. Will turn 43 in December. Faces brutal schedule including five games vs top-4 pass defenses from 2025. SharpFootball analysis shows NFL gave Steelers easiest schedule through Week 8 to keep 'Rodgers farewell tour' in primetime.

story_log.title: Eagles LB Nolan Smith arrested after being clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone
story_log.development: Smith was arrested Friday in Georgia on speeding and reckless driving charges after car clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone. Second-year linebacker facing serious charges ahead of 2026 season.

story_log.title: Ed Orgeron returns to LSU as assistant to Lane Kiffin, seven years after national title
story_log.development: Coach O hired as special assistant to recruiting and defense under new LSU coach Lane Kiffin. Led LSU to 2019 national championship as head coach before being fired in 2021. Decades-long friendship with Kiffin. Pardon My Take interviewed both at LSU facilities during Grit Week.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani homers on first pitch then throws 5 scoreless innings in Dodgers win
story_log.development: Ohtani led off game with homer on first pitch vs Padres, then pitched 5 scoreless innings (44 IP this season, still under 1.00 ERA at 0.73). Escaped bases-loaded jam in 5th with roar. Historic two-way dominance continues.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong calls his back-to-back errors 'genuinely laughable'
story_log.development: Cubs center fielder called his errors over past two games 'laughable' after ball scooted under glove in 2nd inning of 5-0 loss to Brewers. Tough couple days for PCA defensively.

story_log.title: Trey Yesavage outduels Cam Schlittler in young ace showdown as Blue Jays beat Yankees 2-1
story_log.development: Blue Jays' Yesavage bested Yankees' Schlittler in marquee matchup of young aces. Toronto won 2-1 in pitcher's duel. Yesavage struck out Aaron Judge three times (19 Ks in 11.1 IP vs NYY this season including playoffs).

story_log.title: Joey Chestnut to defend hot dog title while on probation after pleading guilty to battery
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: 17-time Nathan's champion will compete in July 4 contest while on probation after pleading guilty to misdemeanor battery charge. Still the reigning champ despite legal issues.

story_log.title: Raiders' Klint Kubiak says No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza has been 'as advertised' in first month
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Raiders coach praised Mendoza's strong first month with team. No. 1 overall pick making positive impression in OTAs. Schefter highlighted Kubiak's comments about Mendoza meeting expectations.

story_log.title: Joe Burrow declares 2026 Bengals 'most talented' roster of his era after big offseason
story_log.development: Burrow told media he believes this year's Bengals squad is most talented roster he's played with since joining franchise. Changed tune after calling for change at end of last season. Kid Cudi visited practice after Cincinnati concert.

story_log.title: Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, Kon Knueppel headline unanimous All-Rookie First Team
story_log.development: NBA announced All-Rookie teams with Flagg, Harper, and Knueppel as unanimous first-team selections. VJ Edgecombe and Cedric Coward also made first team. Ace Bailey, Jeremiah Fears, Collin Murray-Boyles, Maxime Raynaud, and Derik Queen on second team. Neither rookie APG or BPG leader made a team.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle baptizes Isaiah Hartenstein with vicious poster dunk
story_log.development: Castle threw down poster dunk on Hartenstein in Game 2, leaving Wemby and SGA in shock on bench. One of dunks of the year. Hartenstein later appeared to grab Castle's hair and pull him down (no call).

story_log.title: Spurs-Thunder Game 1 averaged 9.2M viewers, most-watched WCF Game 1 in league history
story_log.development: Monday's double-OT thriller peaked at 12M viewers, averaged 9.2M on NBC/Peacock. Most-watched Western Conference finals Game 1 in NBA history. Wemby vs SGA drawing massive numbers.

story_log.title: Brewers and Athletics both score on little-league home runs in wild night
story_log.development: Dom Smith's little-league HR scared Chris Sale. Pete Crow-Armstrong let ball scoot under glove, Brewers scored on error. Later Mike Trout and Josh Lowe both botched fly ball in extras, A's took lead and won.

story_log.title: Blue Jays' Jose Berrios undergoes Tommy John surgery, out into 2027
story_log.development: Veteran Blue Jays starter underwent full Tommy John surgery on right elbow Wednesday. Will be sidelined well into 2027 season. Blow to Toronto rotation.

story_log.title: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice ordered to serve 30 days in jail immediately after probation violation
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Rice sentenced to serve 30 days immediately in Dallas County jail after testing positive for marijuana in violation of probation. Also recovering from knee surgery (out 2 months). Will rehab while incarcerated, miss all OTAs and minicamp.

story_log.title: NFL approves 10 international games starting in 2027, strips teams' ability to protect home games
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: NFL owners voted to increase cap on international games from 8 to 10 in 2027. Also eliminated teams' ability to protect any home games from being played abroad. Could reach 11 with NFLPA approval. Major expansion of global footprint.

story_log.title: Knicks pull off historic 22-point comeback in Game 1 ECF, Brunson hunts Harden in largest playoff comeback since 1970
story_log.development: Knicks rallied from 22 points down with 7 minutes left in 4Q, went on 44-11 run to force OT and win 115-104. Jalen Brunson hunted James Harden repeatedly down the stretch, finished with 38-5-6. Harden had 15 pts, 5-16 FG, 6 TOV, 5 fouls. Largest playoff comeback win in Knicks history and since 1970. Cavs blew 99.9% win probability.

story_log.title: Mavs fire Jason Kidd as Masai Ujiri makes first major move
